akatz.anchorBrief: Image 1 is the source frame to edit. Image 2 is character identity only: <description>. Replace ONLY <target> with that single character. Match the exact source pose, face angle, gaze, mouth opening, expression, limb placement, scale and occlusions. Preserve all other people, the entire original scene, camera framing, lighting and aspect ratio. Keep the reference identity and costume; do not copy the reference pose or background. One full-aspect edited source frame.
akatz.cleanBrief: Remove the selected person (<selection>) from this source frame and reconstruct the empty background. Preserve camera framing, scene geometry, lighting, all unrelated people and objects. Produce a clean opening backplate at the exact same aspect ratio.

nodePack.unpatchedOnNormalComfyUI: works by design with system ffmpeg AND ffprobe on PATH (Akatz's qualification); the graph must then send '480'/'768' strings; ComfyUI rejects integer 480 against ['480','768'] (value_not_in_list, execution.py combo check). Static API check against ComfyUI v0.41 (fc04da91) found every private H3 symbol the pack imports. This machine has /usr/bin/ffmpeg and ffprobe 6.1.1, PyAV 19.0.2, imageio-ffmpeg 0.6.0. INT8 kernel fix applies only to comfy-kitchen 0.2.35 (here 0.2.37).
